# Find ecosystems and schemas to join

Being trusted lets peers connect to you. Doing something useful with credentials means joining the ecosystem that governs them, in the role you need: issuer to issue, verifier to request presentations, holder to receive a credential about your service.

## Browse

The frontend's **Discover & Join** lists every active ecosystem with its governance framework, trust state, counters, and schema cards. The [trust graph search](https://search.testnet.verana.network) answers questions across ecosystems: which ones govern a given kind of credential, how many issuers each has.

## Read a schema before you apply

For the schema you need, note three things:

| | Where | What it decides |
|---|---|---|
| Onboarding mode for your role | schema card | **Open**: you self-create, instantly. **Ecosystem onboarding process** or **grantor onboarding process**: an onboarding process with a validator, with evidence and fees. |
| Fees and validity | the schema's participant tree with **Business Rules** on, and the schema card | What you pay to join and for how long the accreditation lasts |
| Pricing asset | schema card | The v4 frontend pays fees in the native coin only; a schema priced in trust units or fiat is browsable but its paid actions are disabled for now |

Read the ecosystem's governance framework: it states the evidence, the obligations and what gets a participant revoked or slashed. Frameworks written from the Verana Council's [Template EGF](https://github.com/verana-labs/verana-council-gov/tree/main/template-egf) share one structure, so the onboarding criteria, fees and sanctions are in the same place in each.

## From the indexer

```bash
curl -s 'https://idx.testnet.verana.network/v4/ecosystem/list?trust_data=summary' | jq '.ecosystems[] | {id, did, name: .trust_data.name}'
curl -s 'https://idx.testnet.verana.network/v4/credential-schema/list?ecosystem_id=<id>' | jq '.schemas[] | {id, title: .json_schema.title, issuer_onboarding_mode, verifier_onboarding_mode, holder_onboarding_mode, pricing_asset}'
curl -s 'https://idx.testnet.verana.network/v4/participant/list?schema_id=<id>&role=ISSUER_GRANTOR&participant_state=ACTIVE&trust_data=summary' | jq '.participants[] | {id, did, validation_fees}'
```
